Name: Simple Pouch
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Simple Pouch 1.6[/color][/b][/size][/center]

Simple Pouch gives your farmer a separate storage panel beside the backpack. It starts with 12 slots and can be upgraded to 60 without changing your backpack or taking up one of its slots. The interface uses Stardew Valley’s familiar colours, borders, and fonts.
Join the Adventurer’s Guild and reach mine floor 20, then collect your starter pouch for free from Marlon’s shop. The invitation arrives the following morning, but you can collect the pouch even if the letter is missing or unread. Empty it before taking it to Clint for an upgrade.
[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Clean classic settings[/color][/heading]
The seven pouch settings are grouped under [b]Sorting[/b], [b]Pickup[/b] and [b]Crafting[/b]. Clear On/Off checkboxes and lighter value controls make choices easier to read. Click a value to cycle its existing options. A smaller gear opens settings, and [b]Done[/b] returns to your items with mouse or controller support.
Native pouch item details stay above [b]Organise[/b] and [b]Deposit[/b], retaining item descriptions, food effects and unlocked catalogue prices. Your saved contents, favourites, upgrades and configuration choices carry over.
[b]Use pouch items for crafting[/b] starts Off. Enable it in the Crafting group when you want pouch ingredients available for crafting and cooking. Auto-pickup also starts Off.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙️ Installation instructions[/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Pouch.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]SimplePouch[/code]folder in your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]If you previously used [b]Simple Pockets[/b], remove its old mod folder before installing Simple Pouch. Your saved pouch contents and upgrades will carry over.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Main features[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Upgrade from 12 to 24, 36, 48, and finally 60 slots.[/*]
[*]Open the pouch beside your backpack and keep Tab’s normal backpack behaviour.[/*]
[*]Organise items, mark favourites, and deposit matching backpack items.[/*]
[*]Optionally use pouch ingredients for crafting and cooking; this starts Off.[/*]
[*]Enable auto-pickup if you want it. It starts [b]off[/b], and its pickup filter starts at [b]All items[/b].[/*]
[*]Play in any of Stardew Valley’s 12 built-in languages.[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Requirements[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/heading]
Better Crafting, Lookup Anything, Generic Mod Config Menu and Simple Tool Delivery have optional integrations; none is required. [b]Carried containers[/b]
Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47941]Carryable Chests 1.2.2[/url] with containers stored in the pouch or Grandpa's Toolbelt. Carried containers retain their contents and stay tracked without duplicate restoration.
For upgraded fridges, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52739]Simple Fridge Upgrade 1.3[/url] with [b]Simple Pouch 1.6[/b]. Both mods work together; the other storage mods remain optional.
If carried-container support is unavailable, a translated notice asks you to place the container before depositing it. Containers already stored in the pouch can still be withdrawn.
Everyone in a multiplayer game should install the same version of Simple Pouch.
